visual_description: A sea-flute, or perhaps a tentacled saxophone—its curves organic, its purpose unclear.
emotional_response: Surreal lust. Something you would play... or be played by.
rational_analysis: Music and biology fused. Symbol of pleasure and signal.
existential_reflection: If Mizontresh speaks, is this the shape its voice takes? Winding. Wet. Untranslatable.
